messages:
Evan Morris: Prospect (global payments) escalated their vendor risk review. Key asks: hard 72-hour breach notice, CAIQ/SIG evidence, RCA timelines, and whether Redwood will notify regulators. They want exact contract language.

Harpreet Kaur: We should distinguish detection vs confirmation. Operational target: initial customer notification within 72 hours of confirmation where reasonably practicable. We shouldn't promise 72 hours from detection.

Sofia Alvarez: Offer redacted CAIQ + SOC2 summary under NDA. For IR proof, provide a redacted runbook excerpt and tabletop cadence (annual company-wide + quarterly service drills for Dedicated).

Evan Morris: Customer insists on an unconditional 72h clause. Can Legal accept?

Legal Bot: We avoid absolute timeboxes. Proposed clause: "Upon confirmation of a Security Incident materially affecting Customer Data, Redwood will use commercially reasonable efforts to provide Customer with an initial notification describing the nature and known impacts of the incident within seventy-two (72) hours of confirmation where reasonably practicable. Notification timing may be delayed to preserve forensic integrity or comply with law enforcement directives; Redwood will inform Customer if such constraints apply." Include: severity, affected systems, preliminary impact, mitigation actions, and point of contact.

Sofia Alvarez: RCA cadence: preliminary findings within ~10 business days, draft RCA ~30 days, final RCA typically 30-90 days depending on complexity and third-party forensics.

Harpreet Kaur: Channels: primary = customer's designated security contact email + account lead phone; secondary = customer portal advisory for Dedicated/Private. We don't unilaterally file regulator notices on customer's behalf unless contractually authorized. We'll provide cooperation and artifacts for customer filings.

IR Watch: Recommend adding a transparency cadence: for Sev1 incidents provide status updates every 24 hours until containment and a named on-call POC for Enterprise/Dedicated customers (optionally in SLA).

Evan Morris: I'll draft the response: include CAIQ offer (NDA), redacted runbook snippet, proposed clause, RCA cadence, channels, and the 24-hour status cadence + Dedicated SLA options. Can someone review?

Sofia Alvarez: I'll review for accuracy.

Harpreet Kaur: I'll check legal phrasing with Contracts.

Evan Morris: Thanks team :thumbsup:
